claims: FC Barcelona secured a 2-0 victory against Deportivo Abanca in Liga F at Riazor on March 15, 2026.
Alexia Putellas sealed the win, assisted by Caroline Graham Hansen.
The victory allowed FC Barcelona to maintain their top position in the league.
The match was a 2025-26 Spanish Liga F match.
An ESPN article noted an 8-0 win for Barcelona over Deportivo in 2016.
This refers to the women's teams as of March 2026.
